claims.disproof_condition: 條件：牧德下一份年報或季報寫出 PCB AOI 營收轉為年減、或主要客戶改回向 KLA 等海外廠採購；或板廠一手寫出檢測設備改向別家。核查頻率：每月（月營收）＋每季（財報）＋每年（年報）。觸發後 48 小時：這條 claim 降 confidence，重讀檢測設備層讀圖。
claims.statement: Supplier-side statement (Machvision FY2025 annual report): 2025 revenue was NT$3.191 billion, up 108.34%, from visual-inspection (25%), circuit-inspection (33%) and other inspection systems (34%) plus service; its products cover drilling/routing measurement, PCB circuit inspection, HDI and IC-substrate inspection, server-mainboard inspection and four-wire electrical testers; for PCB circuit AOI its main foreign competitors are KLA, CIMS (ex-Camtek PCB) and SCREEN; and in an industry-wide passage on AOI (semiconductor, flat-panel display, LED, PCB and optical lens) it says domestic and foreign users will gradually raise the share of AOI equipment bought from Taiwanese makers. Self-reported.
